data.name: AutoThemeLabel
data.value: Gusoshye gushyirwa kuri icyemezo cyawe kigira ngo gitangire gushyirwamo mu buryotse bw'uburyo butandukanye (light/dark) bwa Windows.

data.name: CursorHint
data.value: Imezo y'icyemezo ishobora gushyirwamo ku buri munsi w'iki cyangwa mu bikorwa bya 'System Optimization'.

data.name: PluginDescription
data.value: Gutunganya ubuzima bw'icyemezo cya mouse n'uburyoshye bwa mouse.

data.name: SettingsSubtitle
data.value: Usanzura icyemezo cy'uburyihano bw'ikurikirana n'uburyishyiramo bwa buryuma ku muntu w'Windows uzi.

data.name: StatusApplySwapFail
data.value: Bishoboye gusanzura intego yo guhindura buryuma.

data.name: StatusCursorApplyFailed
data.value: Bishoboye gusanzura uburyo bw'ikurikirana bwa gusa. Koresha nk'umutsigirizwa (administrator) niba urwo ruzinda kurusha kugira ngo ibyemezo bya INF bigaragara.

data.name: StatusReloaded
data.value: Inzira z'ibikorwa bya plugins zikoresha ubu ni zangiwe

data.name: StatusSyncedFromWindows
data.value: Uburenganzira bwa umare mu Windows buguzwe

data.name: StatusWindowsDefaultRestored
data.value: Uburenganzira bw’umukorwa bwa windows ku bury’ingenzi bwa Windows buguzwe

data.name: StatusRestoreWindowsDefaultFailed
data.value: Ntabwo bishoboye gushimisha uburyo busanzwe bw'ikurikirana (cursor) buwa Windows

data.name: StatusResetDefaults

data.value: Shaka kubona uburyo bw'icyemezo kigira uruhare kabaca mbere yo kwandika kuri profil y'ubu ya Windows.

data.value: Yongeremo cyangwa bikweze uburyo bwa intombwa bw'auto-theme burimo guhitamo ubwo butarimo umucyo w'Windows (light/dark mode).

data.name: WindowsOptimization_Action_CustomMouse_AutoTheme_Disable_Title
data.value: Gusohora Ithemuri y'Intombwa yo Kwinana Gusa

data.name: WindowsOptimization_Action_CustomMouse_AutoTheme_Disable_Description
data.value: Kurinda guhinduka gusanzwe kwa theme ya intombwa bitewe n'ibikorwa bya Windows
